## Change classification

- [ ] UX / accessibility

## Security, compatibility, and rollback impact

## Regression evidence

- [ ] Reproduction or failing pre-fix evidence is linked
- [ ] A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it
- [ ] If automation is impossible, the reason and reviewed manual proof are included
- [ ] No unrelated feature surface was added

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant smoke, security, and documentation checks
- [ ] Changelog/docs/migration/rollback/package contents updated when required
- [ ] External beta or council claims are labeled honestly and link real evidence
